title: Dataset Model: PDS, Members & Catalogs
description: Enumerate catalog entries and dataset attributes. Map the storage namespace and trust-sensitive datasets.

steps.title: Connect & Login
steps.screen:
TSO/E LOGON

Userid ===> HERC01
Password ===> ********

Enter LOGON parameters below:

Procedure ===> IKJACCNT
Acct Nmbr  ===> ACCT#
Size       ===> 4096

Enter an 'S' before each option desired below:
  -Nomail   -Nonotice   -Reconnect   -OIDcard
steps.expected: Log in to TSO to establish identity.
steps.hint: Enter your TSO userid and password. The userid becomes your high-level qualifier (HLQ).

steps.title: Enter RFE (ISPF)
steps.screen:
READY

rfe

 RFE - MVS 3.8j Turnkey System

Option ===>_

0  Settings     1  Browse      2  Edit
3  Utilities    4  Foreground  5  Batch
6  Command      7  Dialog      8  LM
9  IBM          10 SCLM        11 Workplace

F1=Help  F3=Exit
steps.hint: Type RFE at the READY prompt. Unlike Unix, the mainframe has no filesystem hierarchy — datasets use dot-separated qualifiers.

steps.title: Navigate to Utilities
steps.screen:
RFE - MVS 3.8j Turnkey System

Option ===> 3

0  Settings     1  Browse      2  Edit
3  Utilities    4  Foreground  5  Batch
6  Command      7  Dialog      8  LM

F1=Help  F3=Exit
steps.hint: Type 3 to access dataset utilities including DSLIST.

steps.title: Dataset List — User Datasets
steps.screen:
DSLIST - Data Sets Matching HERC01.*

Command - Enter "/" to select action
----------------------------------------------------
         HERC01.CNTL
         HERC01.JCL
         HERC01.LOAD
         HERC01.SOURCE

Command ===>
steps.expected: List datasets under your HLQ (high-level qualifier).
steps.hint: Type 4 for DSLIST, then enter HERC01 as the pattern. Your HLQ is tied to your identity.

steps.title: System Dataset Namespace
steps.screen:
DSLIST - Data Sets Matching SYS1.*

Command - Enter "/" to select action
----------------------------------------------------
         SYS1.BRODCAST
         SYS1.LINKLIB          PO   U     0     32760
         SYS1.LPALIB           PO   U     0     32760
         SYS1.NUCLEUS          PO   U     0     32760
         SYS1.PARMLIB          PO   FB    80    3120
         SYS1.PROCLIB          PO   FB    80    3120

Command ===>
steps.expected: Identify critical system datasets: PARMLIB, PROCLIB, LINKLIB.
steps.hint: Change the pattern to SYS1 to list system datasets. There is no /etc — system config lives in datasets.

steps.title: Browse SYS1.PARMLIB
steps.expected: SYS1.PARMLIB is a PDS containing system configuration members.
steps.hint: A PDS (Partitioned Data Set) is like a directory — each member is a named record. PARMLIB holds IPL and system config.

steps.title: Catalog Structure — LISTCAT
steps.screen:
READY

LISTCAT ENT('SYS1.LINKLIB')

NONVSAM ------- SYS1.LINKLIB
     IN-CAT --- CATALOG.SYS1.MASTER
     HISTORY
       DATASET-OWNER-----(NULL)
       CREATION--------1999.001
       RELEASE----------------2
     VOLUMES
       VOLSER------------MVSRES
       DEVTYPE------X'3050200F'

READY
steps.expected: Understand how the catalog maps dataset names to physical volumes.
steps.hint: The catalog is the namespace. RACF profiles control who can access each cataloged dataset. LISTCAT shows where datasets physically reside.

steps.title: Lab Complete
steps.screen:
Dataset Model Lab Complete

Key concepts:
- PDS = Partitioned Dataset (library with members)
- HLQ = High-Level Qualifier (tied to identity)
- SYS1.PARMLIB controls system config
- Catalog maps names to physical DASD volumes
- Trust-sensitive: PARMLIB, PROCLIB, LINKLIB

Warning: Write access to PARMLIB or PROCLIB = system control.
steps.expected: Map the storage namespace and identify trust-sensitive datasets.
steps.hint: Always logoff cleanly — disconnecting locks your userid. Use /C U=userid at the Hercules console to recover.
